page.overview:
What is Pawmo?

Pawmo is a small rodent whose fur color is light orange. It has the standard Electric-Rodent Electricity Sacs on its cheeks as well as additional ones on its forepaws, it has large arms and five fingers. The fur at the end of its arms and on its hands is a light cream color.

Pawmo evolves from Pawmi starting at level 18 and evolves into Pawmot if leveled up while outside of its Poké Ball after walking 1000 steps using the Let's Go! feature.

Like its evolution and pre-evolution, Pawmo is based on a , such as the , which was thought to have dissapeared following the end of the Pleistocene epoch in the before it was successfully reintroduced to the mountainous range in 1948. Its ability of discharging electricity from its paws may be inspired by defibrillators, with its Fighting-type and learning Arm Thrust upon evolving is likely a grim reference to the potential injuries caused by CPR.

The requirement to evolve Pawmo into Pawmot with the Let's Go! feature is a likely reference to Ash's Pikachu, who is always outside of his Poké Ball throughout the entire anime.
